notes: Jobs: each posting links to the real job page (the employer's site, or the agency's listing), never a site's home page; descriptions come in full from the employer's job system when it has a public one (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters); postings first listed more than three months ago are marked.

New in the studio: Jobs. Every morning a job search in your private repository looks for new postings that fit the role types, places and limits in jobs/preferences.json, ranks them against your graph's skills, and lists them here with the reasons and warnings (for example German required). From each you can write a CV and letter, add it to Applications, save it or set it aside.
